company_foundation.overview: MoFlo is an AI growth platform for small and medium-sized businesses that creates and manages marketing content—social posts, email campaigns, blog articles, and review responses—through apps including MoSocial, MoMail, MoBlogs, and MoReviews, delivered via the MoFlo Cloud platform.
company_foundation.business_model: SaaS subscription: individual apps billed monthly ($79–$149/mo) or a Business Bundle at $299/mo, month-to-month with a 7-day free trial.

positioning.pitch: The all-in-one AI Growth Platform for small businesses: Flo creates your content while you run your business.
positioning.founding_story: Co-founders Nathan and Tristan Cocozza conceived MoFlo over Christmas 2024 in England while discussing AI, noting large companies captured nearly 90% of U.S. AI investment while small businesses got a sliver. MoFlo raised its first funding round in April 2025, incorporated as a Delaware corporation headquartered in Las Vegas in May 2025, launched a beta of MoSocial and MoLetters in August 2025, and launched MoFlo Cloud in October 2025.

market.buyers: Small and medium-sized business owners and small teams, including real estate professionals, insurance agents and brokers, professional services firms, franchise operators, trades and services companies, and high tech professionals.
market.customer_needs: Consistent on-brand marketing across social, email, blogs and Google reviews without the time, expertise, or cost of running marketing in-house; lead generation, reputation management, local visibility, and client communication.
market.ideal_persona: A small business owner or small team without a marketing department or time to run marketing, who wants AI-drafted content ready to approve and publish.
market.industry_groupings: Real estate, insurance, professional services (attorneys, accountants, financial advisors, consultants), franchises, trades and services (e.g., HVAC, roofing, pest control), high tech.
market.channel: Self-serve online signup and onboarding via MoFlo Cloud, supplemented by demo requests and sales contact.

branding.writing_style: Friendly, conversational and benefit-driven, with casual touches ("Who the heck is MoFlo?") and a focus on time savings, simplicity, and affordability for small business owners.

offering.feature: Every app on the platform (MoSocial, MoMail, MoBlogs, MoReviews) in one subscription; integrations, FloGen generation and Brand Power scoring included.
offering.pricing: 7 days free, then $299/month; cancel anytime, no contracts or setup fees.

Automated SEO-optimized blog content creation, publishing straight to WordPress.
